architecture.mechanism: Use an optimized ensemble machine‑learning model to predict the compatibility and performance of a vehicle with a hybrid electric powertrain.
architecture.intervention: Apply the ensemble model to the electric vehicle’s design data, simulating hybrid‑electric integration to identify configurations that exceed Tesla Model Y speed and BYD efficiency.
architecture.expected_effect: The EV will achieve a higher top speed and lower energy consumption (greater efficiency) than the reference vehicles.
architecture.falsification_test: Run the ensemble model on the EV’s technical parameters; if the predicted speed and efficiency metrics do not surpass the Tesla Model Y speed and BYD efficiency thresholds, the mechanism is falsified.
